name: Peanut Butter-Granola Pinwheel Bento Box with Grapes, String Cheese & Cucumber

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes a 4-compartment bento box. Please adjust the recipe as needed to accommodate the size of your bento box or food storage containers.
Wash, dry, trim, and slice cucumber crosswise into thin rounds. Place in one of the small compartments of the bento box.
Place string cheese in the other small compartment of the bento box. (If the cheese does not fit, remove packaging and cut in half.)
Wash, dry, and place grapes in the medium compartment of the bento box.
Place lavash (about 8 x 10-inches in size) on a flat surface. Spread peanut butter over the bread in an even layer, making sure to spread it out to the edges.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (8 x 10-inch) piece lavash bread
¼ cup natural peanut butter

instructions.primary_message: Sprinkle granola evenly over the peanut butter. With the short edge of the lavash facing towards you, tightly roll the bread into a cylinder. Slice bread crosswise into 6 even pieces and place in the large compartment of the bento box.
Cover bento box and refrigerate until ready to eat. Enjoy!
